$meta.name: MemoryCare design tokens
$meta.source_of_truth: This file. tokens.css and tokens.json are BOTH generated from it by build-tokens.py. Never edit the generated files.
$meta.palette_rule: Every colour on screen is one of the seven brief colours, or one of them at an alpha over another one of them. No new hex is authored anywhere in this system.

groups.title: PALETTE — the seven. Never reference a --mc-color-* from a component.
groups.comment: Ratios in the notes are computed by tools/check-contrast.py from these hex values. See CONTRAST.md.

tokens.name: color-dark-olive
tokens.comment: 12.93 on Nude, 14.17 on Ivory, 10.26 on Sky. Body text on light; the dark band ground.

tokens.name: color-olive
tokens.comment: DECOR ONLY. Fails as text on every ground: 3.12 Nude / 3.42 Ivory / 4.14 Dark Olive / 2.48 Sky.

tokens.name: color-nude
tokens.comment: The page ground.

tokens.name: color-ivory
tokens.comment: The objects on the ground: cards, sheets, inputs, header.

tokens.name: color-sky
tokens.comment: 10.26 on Dark Olive. 1.26 on Nude, 1.38 on Ivory - invisible. Dark-ground type; tint fill on light. CONTESTED: the brandbook colour page prints #D4ECF9; all twelve delivered files paint #A4D6E8. Working value is what the artwork contains.

tokens.name: color-deep-olive
tokens.comment: Not in the brandbook. Links and accent text on light: 5.49 Nude / 6.01 Ivory. 2.36 on Dark Olive - never there.

tokens.name: color-error
tokens.comment: Not in the brandbook. Validation only. 6.10 Nude / 6.69 Ivory. 2.12 on Dark Olive - INVISIBLE.

groups.title: ALPHA CHANNELS — the only way this system makes a new value.
groups.comment: Dark Olive and Ivory as rgb() with an alpha. Every resulting composite is measured in CONTRAST.md against the ground it is used on. Nothing here is a new colour; it is one brand colour seen through another.

tokens.name: ink-a10
tokens.comment: Dark Olive 10%. Subtle hairline.

tokens.name: ink-a20
tokens.comment: Dark Olive 20%. Default hairline. 1.48 on Nude - decorative separation only, never a control boundary.

tokens.name: ink-a56
tokens.comment: Dark Olive 56%. 3.55 on Nude, 3.66 on Ivory - clears the 3.0 needed for a control boundary (WCAG 1.4.11).

tokens.name: ink-a72
tokens.comment: Dark Olive 72%. 5.67 on Nude, 5.96 on Ivory - clears 4.5, so it may carry text.

tokens.name: ink-a08
tokens.comment: Dark Olive 8%. Sunken well / striped table row.

tokens.name: ink-scrim
tokens.comment: Modal scrim.

tokens.name: paper-a06
tokens.comment: Ivory 6% on the dark band. Raised object without inventing a fifth dark.

tokens.name: paper-a24
tokens.comment: Ivory 24% on dark. 2.07 - decorative hairline.

tokens.name: paper-a48
tokens.comment: Ivory 48% on dark. 4.33 - clears 3.0 for a control boundary.

tokens.name: wash-error
tokens.comment: Error 8% over Ivory = #EBE1DA. Dark Olive on it 12.53; Error on it 5.91.

groups.title: SURFACE — rule 4 lives here. Nude is the ground; Ivory is the objects on it.

tokens.name: surface-ground
tokens.comment: The page. Nothing else.

tokens.name: surface-object
tokens.comment: Cards, the report sheet, inputs, the header, the modal.

tokens.name: surface-well
tokens.comment: A recess inside an object: table stripe, code, the calculator readout.

tokens.name: surface-float
tokens.comment: Menus, dropdowns, the toast.

tokens.name: surface-inverse
tokens.comment: Use .band--dark, not this, for a whole section.

tokens.name: surface-action
tokens.comment: Primary button fill. Its label is surface-object at 14.17.

tokens.name: surface-action-hover
tokens.comment: Ivory on Deep Olive 6.01 - the label still clears AA on hover.

tokens.name: surface-error-wash
tokens.comment: The error summary panel. Light scope only.

groups.title: DECOR — paint that never has a foreground. Rules 1 and 2 live here.
groups.comment: If you are about to write `color:` with one of these, you have the wrong token. Nothing in this namespace has a text colour that clears 4.5 against it, and none is ever given one. The lint in tools/check-tokens.sh rejects `color:` on any --mc-decor-*.

tokens.name: decor-olive-fill
tokens.comment: Petals, seals, the filled part of a slider track, a season mark, a decorative panel.

tokens.name: decor-olive-rule
tokens.comment: A divider or a rule. 3.12 on Nude - above the 3.0 a meaningful graphic needs.

tokens.name: decor-sky-tint
tokens.comment: Sky as a FILL on light: a chip ground, a callout panel, the medallion. 1.26 on Nude, so it can only be seen as an area, never read as type. Dark Olive ON this tint is 10.26, which is how a Sky-tinted chip carries a label.

tokens.name: text-secondary
tokens.comment: 5.67 / 5.96. Composited, not a new hex.

tokens.name: text-muted
tokens.comment: 3.55 / 3.66. DISABLED LABELS ONLY - WCAG 1.4.3 exempts inactive controls. Never for information.

tokens.name: text-accent
tokens.comment: 5.49 / 6.01. The only colour that marks text apart from body text on light.

tokens.name: text-link-hover
tokens.comment: Darker, not lighter: 12.93. Hover also thickens the underline, so the state does not depend on colour alone.

tokens.name: text-on-action
tokens.comment: On surface-action: 14.17.

tokens.name: text-error
tokens.comment: 6.10 / 6.69. UNDEFINED in .band--dark, where it would measure 2.12.

tokens.name: border-subtle
tokens.comment: Decorative only.

tokens.name: border-default
tokens.comment: Decorative only. 1.48 - not a control boundary.

tokens.name: border-control
tokens.comment: Input and secondary-button boundary. 3.55 / 3.66 against 3.0.

tokens.name: border-focus
tokens.comment: The focus ring on light. 5.49 on Nude, 6.01 on Ivory, and 4.35 on a Sky tint - it survives every light ground this system produces.

tokens.name: border-error
tokens.comment: UNDEFINED in .band--dark.

groups.title: THE DARK BAND — two sections flip, this is not a dark theme.
groups.comment: Everything a light-scope token named is re-pointed here. The two tokens that must NOT survive the flip are re-pointed at deliberately undefined guard names: the var() becomes invalid at computed-value time, so `color` falls back to the inherited Nude and `background-color` to transparent. The page stays readable and the guard name is printed in DevTools as the reason.

tokens.name: surface-object
tokens.comment: Ivory 6% over Dark Olive. A raised card without a fifth dark.

tokens.name: surface-action
tokens.comment: Nude fill, Dark Olive label: 12.93.

tokens.name: text-secondary
tokens.comment: 14.17. On dark there is no dimmed body text - the alpha ramp that works on light does not clear 4.5 here until 48%, and a half-lit paragraph on a memorial page reads as neglect.

tokens.name: text-muted
tokens.comment: 4.33. Disabled labels only.

tokens.name: text-accent
tokens.comment: 10.26. THIS is where Sky becomes type - rule 2.

tokens.name: border-control
tokens.comment: 4.33 against 3.0.

tokens.name: border-focus
tokens.comment: 10.26 - the ring is more visible here than on light.

tokens.name: text-error
tokens.comment: GUARD. Intentionally undefined. Rule 3.

tokens.name: border-error
tokens.comment: GUARD. Intentionally undefined.

tokens.name: surface-error-wash
tokens.comment: GUARD. Intentionally undefined.

groups.title: FONT STACKS.
groups.comment: VERIFIED BY RENDERING EACH GLYPH, not by reading a cmap - see fonts/FONTS.md. GHEA Mariam carries Latin, Cyrillic and Armenian. It MAPS U+058F and DRAWS A POMEGRANATE there, in all four files; a cmap read says the codepoint is present and says nothing about what it draws, which is how that reached the shipped build. Montserrat carries Latin and Cyrillic ONLY: no Armenian, no dram sign - the brandbook's three-script claim is true of the display face and false of the text face. A family called 'Montserrat Armenian' does not exist on Google Fonts; the owner ruled 03.09.2026 that Noto Sans Armenian is the Armenian text face permanently. It also draws the dram sign correctly, which is why mc-dram.woff2 is cut from it.

tokens.name: font-display
tokens.value: "MC Dram", "GHEA Mariam", "Noto Serif Armenian", Georgia, "Times New Roman", serif
tokens.comment: GHEA Mariam: 827 glyphs, three scripts. It MAPS U+058F but DRAWS A POMEGRANATE there, so "MC Dram" must precede it - its unicode-range is U+058F alone, so it can only ever serve that one character and GHEA Mariam keeps everything else.

tokens.name: font-text
tokens.comment: en / ru. Montserrat genuinely has no dram sign. MC Dram is the U+058F-only slice, cut from Noto Sans Armenian - NOT from GHEA Mariam, which draws a pomegranate at that codepoint.

tokens.name: font-text-hy
tokens.comment: am, applied by :lang(hy). MC Dram first so the dram sign is the same drawing in all three locales; Montserrat next so Latin and Cyrillic fragments keep the brand face; Noto Sans Armenian carries the Armenian - the permanent Armenian face, ruled 03.09.2026.

tokens.name: font-numeric
tokens.comment: Used with font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums wherever a number can change: the calculator, the rail, the payments table. MC Dram leads so a price never renders a pomegranate.

groups.title: SPACE — a 4px grid, named by step not by pixel.
LAYOUT — the measurements that keep the page off the 360px floor.
groups.comment: Section padding and the gutter are fluid so that 1440 breathes and 360 does not overflow. --mc-gutter is the only horizontal padding a section is allowed to use.

tokens.name: measure
tokens.comment: Maximum line length for body copy.

tokens.name: measure-tight
tokens.comment: Card copy, form helper text.

tokens.name: width-narrow
tokens.comment: Legal pages, the report sheet column.

tokens.name: target-min
tokens.comment: Minimum interactive target, both axes. WCAG 2.2 2.5.8 asks 24; 44 is the phone floor.

groups.title: RADIUS — the brand is editorial. Square is the default; 2px is a concession to controls.

tokens.name: radius-none
tokens.comment: Photographs, the report sheet, bands, rules, tables.

tokens.name: radius-control
tokens.comment: Buttons, inputs, cards, badges, chips, toasts.

tokens.name: radius-overlay
tokens.comment: Modal, dialog, drawer - a different plane is allowed to say so.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.comment: The slider thumb and the year-rail season dot. Nothing else.

groups.title: ELEVATION — shadow is Dark Olive at an alpha, never a grey.

tokens.name: elevation-1
tokens.comment: A card that has been hovered.

tokens.name: elevation-2
tokens.comment: Menu, dropdown, toast.

tokens.name: elevation-3
tokens.comment: Modal and dialog.

groups.title: MOTION.
groups.comment: base.css zeroes every duration under prefers-reduced-motion by re-declaring these four tokens, so no component has to remember to.

tokens.name: duration-state
tokens.comment: Hover, focus, active.

tokens.name: duration-enter
tokens.comment: A menu, a toast, an accordion panel.

tokens.name: duration-max
tokens.comment: The ceiling. Nothing on this site is slower.

tokens.name: duration-draw
tokens.comment: The medallion line-work, once.

groups.title: Z-INDEX — a closed set. A number typed straight into a rule is a defect.

tokens.name: z-raised
tokens.comment: A hovered card, the sticky table header.

tokens.name: z-dropdown
tokens.comment: Nav submenu, language switcher, plot picker.

tokens.name: z-skiplink
tokens.comment: Above everything: it must be reachable from the first Tab on any page.

type.comment: SIXTEEN ROLES. Not fifteen, not seventeen. The live build renders seventeen distinct sizes with no h1; this replaces that ramp. Sizes are fluid between 360px and 1440px viewport and are emitted as clamp() by the generator, so the ramp arithmetic cannot drift between the CSS and the JSON either. Leading is unitless so it survives the clamp. Floors from the brief: body never below 16, no informational text below 14, inputs 16.

roles.name: display
roles.use: One per site: the hero. Never twice on a page.

roles.name: h1
roles.use: Exactly one per page. The live build has none on any of 36.

roles.name: h4
roles.use: The smallest heading. Text face, because the display face loses its shape here.

roles.name: price-xl
roles.use: The flagship tariff card. Display face, so U+058F is native.

roles.name: price
roles.use: Every other price slot. The slot also has to hold a phrase - see .mc-price--phrase.

roles.name: caption
roles.use: Figure captions, helper text, the report metadata line. The floor.

roles.name: rail
roles.use: The year rail's month labels and the verification rail.

roles.name: eyebrow
roles.use: The line above a heading. Uppercase is in the token, not typed into the copy.

roles.name: button
roles.use: Every button and every input. 16 is also what stops iOS zooming a focused field.

roles.name: legal
roles.use: Policy pages, the bank's twelve items, the card-marks strip caption.
